blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Modern diffusion models are trained on massive datasets that often include copyrighted or private images. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) address this by testing whether a given image was in a model's training set. The standard approach scores an image by its reconstruction loss and flags low-loss images as members. This often fails because some images are simply easier to reconstruct than others, so a simple unseen image can score a lower loss than a complex training image. Difficulty calibration separates memorization from how difficult an image is to begin with. We show how to calibrate along two axes of time: training time and diffusion time. First, across training time, we introduce Reference-Model Calibration (RMC), which compares a fine-tuned model's loss against an earlier checkpoint. This cleanly isolates newly memorized data and gives near-perfect auditing, even without text captions. Since earlier checkpoints are not always available, we next present Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC), which calibrates across diffusion time using only a single model. Our key observation is that an image's difficulty persists across noise levels, whereas memorization is localized in time. By comparing the loss at a target timestep against neighboring timesteps from the same model, TSC attenuates image difficulty using the model's own trajectory. Empirically, our methods beat the state of the art by a wide margin, and unlike most existing attacks, generalize across different model parameterizations such as $x$-, $v$-, and $ε$-prediction models. Code is available at https://github.com/MichaelJoseph777/TSC.
blocks.zh: 现代的传播模型在大型数据集上接受培训,这些数据集往往包括有版权的或私人的图像. 会员推论攻击(MIAs)通过测试一个给定的图像是否在模型的训练集中来解决这个问题. 标准方法通过重建损失和标出低损失图像作为成员来评分. 这往往因为有些图像比其他图像简单更容易重建而失败,所以一个简单的隐形图像可以比复杂的训练图像得到更低的得分. 难以校正的校正将记忆与图像开始的难度区分开来. 我们示范如何按照两个时间轴进行校正:培训时间和传播时间。 首先,在整个培训期间,我们采用参考模型校正(RMC),将一个经过微调的模型的损失与一个较早的检查站进行比较。 这样干净地将新记忆的数据隔离开来,并给予近乎完美的审计,即使没有文本标题. 由于以往的检查站并非总有,我们接下来是临时自我解析(TSC),在扩散期间只使用单一模式校正。 我们的主要观察是,图像的难度在噪声水平之间持续存在,而记忆则是及时本地化的. 通过将目标时间步上的损失与相邻时间步上相同的模型进行比较,TSC利用模型自己的轨迹来减轻图像难度. 从经验上看,我们的方法以相去甚远的距离击败了最先进的技术,并且与大多数现有的攻击不同,概括了不同的模型参数,比如$x-,$v-,和$$-预测模型. 代码见https://github.com/MichaelJoseph777/TSC.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion Models (DMs) ( Song and Ermon, 2019 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2020 ) are currently the method of choice for high-fidelity image generation ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ) . As their success relies heavily on massive, uncurated web-scale datasets, these models often inadvertently absorb personal photographs, copyrighted artworks, and proprietary content. This indiscriminate data collection creates privacy and copyright risks, with recent studies ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Somepalli et al., 2023 ) demonstrating that DMs can memorize and reproduce specific training examples during generation. Consequently, it has become increasingly important to reliably audit the underlying training corpora of these generative models.
blocks.zh: 传播模型(DMs)(Song and Ermon, 2019;Ho等, 2020;Song等, 2020)是目前高真图像生成的选择方法(Rombach等, 2022;Ramesh等, 2022.). 由于这些模型的成功很大程度上依赖于庞大的,未经验证的网络尺度数据集,这些模型往往无意中吸收了个人相片,有版权的艺术品和专有内容. 这种不分青红皂白的数据收集造成了隐私和版权风险,最近的研究(Carlini等,2023;Somepalli等,2023)表明,DMs可以在一代人期间记住并再现具体的训练实例. 因此,越来越需要可靠地审计这些基因模型的基本培训机构。

blocks.en: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) ( Shokri et al., 2017 ) audit this risk by predicting whether a specific sample was part of the training set. While typically framed as a security vulnerability, MIAs can also enable creators to verify whether their proprietary content was used for training. These attacks exploit statistical differences in model behavior on members versus non-members ( Yeom et al., 2018 ) . Although well-studied for earlier generative models such as GANs ( Goodfellow et al., 2020 ) and VAEs ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) , with several attacks developed for these settings ( Hayes et al., 2017 ; Hilprecht et al., 2019 ; Chen et al., 2020 ) , the iterative denoising process of diffusion models makes traditional MIAs considerably less effective ( Duan et al., 2023 ) , motivating approaches tailored specifically to the diffusion process.
blocks.zh: 成员推论攻击(MIAs)(Shokri等,2017年)通过预测特定样本是否是培训的一部分来审计这一风险. 虽然通常被视为一种安全弱点,但MIA也可以使创建者核实其专有内容是否用于培训。 这些攻击利用了成员与非成员在模式行为方面的统计差异(Yeom等,2018年). 虽然对早期的基因模型如GANs(Goodfellow等,2020年)和VAEs(Kingma和Welling,2013年)进行了很好的研究,为这些环境开发了多起攻击(Hayes等,2017年;Hilprecht等,2019年;Chen等,2020年),但传播模型的迭代去名化过程使得传统的MIAs的功效要低得多(Duan等,2023年),激发专门针对传播过程的方法.

blocks.en:
Probably the most standard approach to MIAs is evaluating the models loss on the target examples, and predicting the low loss examples as members. Early approaches applied this to DMs by directly measuring the reconstruction error at a single, isolated timestep ( Matsumoto et al., 2023 ) . While followup work improved upon this ( Duan et al., 2023 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) , a fundamental obstacle limits the accuracy of all these approaches:
There are images that are intrinsically easy that achieve low loss regardless of membership and vice versa. This difficulty factor confounds membership making the loss an unreliable membership metric.
blocks.zh:
MIAs最标准的方法可能是评价目标实例上的模型损失,并预测低损失实例为成员. 早期的方法通过直接测量单个孤立时间步的重建出错,将这一点应用于模式草案(松本等,2023年). 虽然后续行动有所改进(Duan等人,2023年;Kong等人,2024年),但一个根本障碍限制了所有这些方法的准确性:
有一些图象在本质上很容易实现低损失,无论成员如何,反之亦然。 这一困难因素混淆了成员,使损失成为衡量成员情况的不可靠的尺度。

blocks.en: To overcome this confound, we propose difficulty calibration across two time axes: training time and diffusion time . First, across training time, we introduce Reference-Model Calibration (RMC) to audit fine-tuned models. By comparing a sample’s fine-tuned loss against the base checkpoint loss, RMC cleanly isolates newly memorized data from general reconstruction difficult. Note that this strategy is known for Large Language Models ( Wang et al., 2024 ) but is under-explored in DMs. Its limitation is that prior checkpoints are frequently unavailable, and the approach is irrelevant for pretraining corpora. To provide an unconstrained alternative, we propose Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC) , which calibrates across diffusion time using only a single model. TSC leverages the insight that image difficulty persists across nearby noise levels, whereas the membership signal is highly localized in time. By evaluating the relative loss differences between a target timestep and its temporal neighbors, TSC uses the local trajectory as an internal baseline to suppress difficulty-induced variance. This internal calibration isolates the structural deviation of membership, successfully identifying a ”difficult” member even when its absolute loss strictly exceeds that of an ”easy” non-member.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这种困惑,我们建议在两个时间轴上进行困难校正:培训时间和传播时间。 第一,在整个培训期间,我们采用参考模型校正(RMC)来审计经过微调的模型。 RMC通过将样本的微调损失与基地检查站损失进行比较,将新记忆的数据与一般重建困难隔离开来。 注意这一策略以"大语言模型"(Wang等,2024年)而出名,但在DMs中探索不足. 其局限性是,经常没有前哨检查站,这种做法与对公司进行预先培训无关。 为了提供一种不受限制的替代品,我们提议临时自我校正(TSC),这种校正在扩散期间只使用单一的模型。 海训方案利用了一种洞察力,即图像困难在附近噪音水平上持续存在,而会员信号在时间上高度本地化。 通过评价目标时间步与其时间相邻的相对损失差异,海训方案将当地轨迹作为内部基线来抑制由难度引起的相差. 这种内部校准隔离了成员的结构偏差,成功地确定了“困难”成员,即使其绝对损失严格地超过“容易”的非成员。

blocks.en: We evaluate our methods across multiple model architectures, datasets, and training targets. While RMC provides state-of-the-art auditing for fine-tuned Stable Diffusion models, TSC serves as a highly powerful alternative for unconstrained settings. Across DDPM and Stable Diffusion evaluation settings, TSC consistently outperforms prior baselines. On CIFAR-10 ( Krizhevsky et al., 2009 ) , it doubles the performance of existing attacks to reach a 62.3% TPR@1%FPR. Furthermore, we emphasize TSC’s robustness across diverse training objectives. While existing attacks are rigidly tailored to standard noise-prediction models and severely degrade on alternative parameterizations, TSC maintains highly accurate extraction capabilities. Finally, we analyze where the membership signal physically appears along the denoising trajectory, demonstrating that the effective leakage window is intrinsically tied to the underlying training objective.
blocks.zh: 我们通过多个模型架构、数据集和培训目标来评估我们的方法。 虽然RMC为微调的稳定扩散模型提供最先进的审计,但TSC作为不受约束的设置的极强替代品. 在整个DDPM和稳定扩散评价设置中,海训方案的业绩始终高于先前的基线。 在CIFAR-10(Krizhevsky等,2009年)上,它将现有攻击的性能翻了一番,达到了62.3%的TPR@1%FPR. 此外,我们强调海训方案在各种培训目标方面的稳健性。 虽然现有的攻击被僵硬地适应了标准噪声预测模型,并在替代参数化上被严重降解,但海训方案保持了高度精确的取出能力. 最后,我们分析成员信号在去诺伊轨道上的实际出现之处,表明有效的渗出窗口与基本的培训目标有着内在的联系。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We propose TSC , a generalized method for robust membership inference. By evaluating relative loss differences across adjacent timesteps, TSC uses the local trajectory as an internal baseline to mitigate image difficulty and isolate membership signal. • We introduce RMC for auditing fine-tuned models. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to systematically analyze and demonstrate the effectiveness of prior-checkpoint calibration of single-timestep losses for membership inference in diffusion models. • We comprehensively evaluate both methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse architectures and datasets. Notably, TSC consistently yields massive improvements over prior trajectory-based baselines, frequently doubling the true positive rate at strict false-positive thresholds. • We provide a detailed analysis of how the effective denoising timesteps for membership inference shift across different training objectives, extending robust membership inference beyond the standard ϵ \epsilon -prediction, ϵ \epsilon -loss paradigm.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs), originally formalized by Shokri et al. (2017) , aim to determine whether a specific data record was included in a target model’s training set. MIAs are traditionally categorized by the adversary’s capabilities: white-box attacks assume access to model parameters, activations, or gradients ( Nasr et al., 2019 ) , whereas black-box attacks operate under a more restrictive setting, relying exclusively on the model’s observable outputs ( Choquette-Choo et al., 2021 ) . Gray-box attacks occupy an intermediate threat model, granting access to quantities such as loss values or intermediate model states without requiring gradient-level information. In diffusion-model auditing, this distinction is often methodological: attacks that query intermediate denoising states generally assume local access to the model while avoiding the substantially greater computational cost of full white-box analysis. Most such query-based MIAs are threshold-based attacks : they define a continuous membership score 𝒮 θ ​ ( x ) \mathcal{S}_{\theta}(x) , such as reconstruction loss or prediction error, for a target model θ \theta and candidate sample x x , and classify the sample as a member when 𝒮 θ ​ ( x ) < τ {\mathcal{S}_{\theta}(x)<\tau} ( Yeom et al., 2018 ; Carlini et al., 2022 ) . The threshold τ \tau can be empirically calibrated to optimize attack performance, often subject to a desired False Positive Rate (FPR). More sophisticated attacks additionally use shadow models to calibrate the score distribution ( Shokri et al., 2017 ; Carlini et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 成员推断攻击(MIAs)最初由Shokri等人(2017年)正式确定,目的是确定目标模型的培训教材是否包括了具体的数据记录。 MIA传统上被对手的能力分类:白盒攻击假设获得模型参数,激活,或梯度(Nasr等,2019年),而黑盒攻击则在更严格的环境下运行,完全依靠模型的可观测输出(Choquette-Choo等,2021年). 灰盒攻击占据了中间威胁模型,允许访问损失值等数量或中间模型状态而不需要梯度级信息. 在传播-模型审计中,这种区分往往是方法上的:查询中间去诺状态的攻击一般假定本地可以访问模型,同时避免完全白盒分析的计算成本大幅提高. 大多数基于查询的MIA都是基于阈值的攻击: 它们为目标模型 \\theta 和候选样本 x x 定义连续会籍分数 S (x)\mathcal{S}_{\thethata}(x),例如重建损失或预测错误,并在 S & (x) < s{\athcal{S}_{\theta} (x)<\tau} (Yeom等, 2018; Carlini等, 2022) 时将样本归为会籍. 阈值 \ tau 可以经验性地校正以优化攻击性能, 经常受到期望的假正率( FPR) 。 更复杂的攻击还多用影子模型来校正分数分布(Shokri等,2017;Carlini等,2022.).

blocks.en: Auditing diffusion models requires analyzing the iterative denoising trajectory. While Carlini et al. (2022) achieved high precision with the Likelihood Ratio Attack (LiRA), their approach requires training numerous shadow models, making it computationally prohibitive. Consequently, efficient threshold-based attacks have become the standard. Matsumoto et al. (2023) introduced the Naive loss attack, which utilizes the diffusion training loss at specific timesteps as the membership score. To extract a more robust signal, Duan et al. (2023) proposed SecMI, which evaluates the reconstruction error along a deterministic trajectory via DDIM inversion, effectively isolating the membership signal from the high variance of stochastic forward noise. Kong et al. (2024) introduced the Proximal Initialization Attack (PIA), which initializes the forward process with a known deterministic noise vector near the clean data sample. PIA infers membership by evaluating the model’s noise estimation against this explicit ground-truth trajectory, achieving competitive accuracy with a reduced query budget. Finally, for conditional text-to-image models, Zhai et al. (2024) proposed CLiD, which measures the discrepancy between conditional and unconditional diffusion losses to expose memorization specific to the text-image pair.
blocks.zh: 审计传播模型需要分析迭代去声轨迹。 虽然Carlini等人(2022年)在"可能比率攻击"(LiRA)中实现了高精度,但他们的方法需要训练出众多的影子模型,使其在计算上令人望而却步. 因此,有效的以门槛为基础的攻击已成为标准。 Matsumoto等 (2023年)引入了"奈夫损失"(Naive lost attack),它利用特定时间段的传播训练损失作为会员分数. 为了提取出更坚固的信号,Duan等人(2023年)提出SecMI,通过DDIM倒置,按照确定性轨迹来评价重建出错,有效地将会籍信号与相去甚远的相去甚远的前向噪声相隔离. 金刚等. (2024年)引入了"近缘初始化攻击"(PIA),在清洁数据样本附近以已知的确定性噪声矢量来初始化了前进过程. PIA通过根据这种明确的地上真实轨迹来评价模型的噪音估计,通过降低查询预算来实现竞争性的准确性,从而推断入会。 最后,对于有条件的文本到图像模型,Zhai等(2024年)提出了CLiD,它测量有条件和无条件的传播损失之间的相差,以暴露出文本到图像对特有的记忆.

blocks.en: 3.2 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3.2 动机

blocks.en: Most diffusion MIAs rely on a standard premise: models denoise training data more accurately than unseen data. However, absolute denoising loss varies wildly due to image difficulty factors like high-frequency details ( Lian et al., 2025 ) , complex layouts, or rare semantic concepts that make reconstruction harder. Consequently, an ”easy” non-member often incurs a lower loss than a ”difficult” member, deeply entangling the two populations (Fig. 1 ). Disentangling membership from this sample difficulty requires evaluating candidates against an image-specific reference rather than relying on absolute loss.
blocks.zh: 大部分传播 MIAs依赖于一个标准前提:模型denoise训练数据比不见的数据更准确. 然而,由于像高频细节(Lian等,2025年),复杂布局,或罕见的语义概念使重建更加困难等图像难度因素,绝对去声损失差异很大. 因此,“容易”的非成员的损失往往低于“困难”成员,这深深地困扰着这两个群体(图1)。 将会员从这种抽样困难中剔除,需要对照特定形象的参考标准来评价候选人,而不是依赖绝对损失。

blocks.en: For models fine-tuned from a foundational base checkpoint, the original model provides a natural reference across training time . It establishes an accurate baseline of each image’s difficulty before the audited fine-tuning stage. As shown for Stable Diffusion on MS-COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) (Fig. 2 ), the losses produced by the two checkpoints are highly correlated. However, subtracting the pretrained loss to compute the fine-tuning residual reveals a stark separation: members systematically shift toward lower fine-tuned loss, while non-members remain concentrated near zero.

blocks.en: While a pretrained checkpoint provides an exceptionally strong baseline, assuming access to one is often unrealistic and irrelevant for auditing pretraining corpus. To achieve difficulty calibration without privileged external models, our primary method instead calibrates across diffusion time , leveraging the denoising trajectory itself as a self-contained internal reference. Because image difficulty generally evolves smoothly across nearby noise levels, adjacent timesteps provide an image-specific estimate of the local loss baseline. Membership, however, often manifests as a localized deviation from this baseline. As illustrated in Figure 3 , comparing each loss against its local temporal reference largely cancels out overall image difficulty, successfully separating members from non-members based purely on trajectory shape.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced difficulty calibration across two time axes to mitigate the image-difficulty confound in diffusion MIAs. Reference-Model Calibration (RMC) calibrates across training time using a pretrained checkpoint, while Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC) calibrates across diffusion time using the image’s own denoising trajectory. Experiments across diverse datasets, architectures, and training objectives demonstrate substantial gains in strict low-FPR membership detection. RMC enables near-perfect uncaptioned auditing of fine-tuned data, and TSC frequently doubles the TPR@1%FPR of the strongest trajectory-based baselines in fully unconstrained settings.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
Membership inference has both privacy risks and legitimate auditing uses.
Improved attacks could be misused to infer an individual’s participation in
sensitive training data. At the same time, these methods can help individuals
investigate whether their personal data were used to train or fine-tune
diffusion models, and can support audits of candidate training-data sources
for publicly released models, including those distributed through platforms
such as Hugging Face. Such audits can help assess claims about dataset use
and improve transparency around model provenance. Membership scores provide
statistical evidence about candidate examples: a negative result does not
prove that an example was excluded from training, and an audit does not
identify a model’s complete training dataset. We advocate using these methods
for authorized privacy auditing and accountability, with conclusions that
account for false positives and false negatives.
